## What changed

Describe the user problem and the solution. Link the issue with `Closes #…` when appropriate.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has test coverage
- [ ] Visible UI changes include desktop and relevant narrow-viewport evidence

## Impact

- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] Accessibility was considered
- [ ] Security and authorization boundaries were considered
- [ ] Data migrations or environment changes are documented
- [ ] No real attendee data, credentials, or sensitive logs are included

## Screenshots or recordings

Add before/after evidence for visible changes, or write “Not applicable.”
